summary: News sweep of the Federal Register issues of 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10 (read through the Federal Register API and the GovInfo PDFs it returns; no presidential documents on either day), the Supreme Court orders page and docket for No. 26-239 (redistributed for the 2026-11-13 conference, no order), the White House presidential actions page, three Federal Register documents of 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 not read in the previous run, and watch-item searches. Mapped developments: the BIS final rule of 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70789) extending the suspension of the export control affiliates rule through 2027-01-10 (c21-03, c26-11, c00-12); the CMS final rule of 2026-11-09 codifying the Medicare drug price negotiation program at 42 CFR part 429 (91 FR 72176, effective 2026-12-05; c14-11 stays diverged); two USDA SNAP proposed rules of 2026-11-10 on categorical eligibility and work-requirement waivers (91 FR 72454 and 91 FR 72439; c10-01, c00-10); the Labor Department final rule of 2026-11-06 on equal opportunity in registered apprenticeship (91 FR 70164, effective 2027-01-05; c18-08, c00-01); and the Education Department proposed supplemental priorities of 2026-11-05 (91 FR 69736; c00-05). The CBP interim final rule on foreign importers of record (91 FR 69977) does not bear on c21-14 and was not added. Rotation: 15 freshness checks (c12-07, c26-05, c11-15, c27-05, c19-09, c11-32, c22-26, c22-27, c07-19, c09-09, c05-26, c06-22, c13-05, c04-14, c27-18; six without change) and 10 refutation checks (c09-02, c06-05, c08-03, c02-06, c09-03, c09-04, c06-02, c06-03, c02-19, c09-12; all hold). One stage changed: c18-08 moved from proposed 15 to in_progress 25 because the registered apprenticeship equal-opportunity rule is final but not yet effective. One court status was relabeled: c00-11 from stayed to pending, matching c05-03 on the same case. Every changed record was independently reviewed with the chapter text checked. Counted set 627: proposed 160, in progress 209.
title: Twice-weekly run: one stage change (c18-08 to in_progress), 30 records updated
